description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Twin Element Mode III (Ice, Lightning) v2], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Unexpected Assault Mode] to the user, grants [Instant Cast 1]/[100% Critical 3] to the user if 0-3/4+ FF11 allies are alive, grants [Critical Damage +50% 3] and [Instant Cast 1] to all allies if 4+ FF11 allies are alive

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
